findings.title: HTTP/WS/MCP carrier has zero authentication; jwt_secret and rate_limit_rpm are dead config fields
findings.description: 5 routes mounted with only TraceLayer; any local process can call /api/v1/chat, /api/v1/ws, /api/v1/mcp. HttpConfig declares jwt_secret/rate_limit_rpm (daemon.rs:29-30) but nothing reads them. Mitigation: validate_loopback refuses non-loopback bind.
findings.exploit_scenario: Any malware/process on the host opens 127.0.0.1:9876/api/v1/mcp and invokes non-Confidential tools (tier3_search, fs.read, web.fetch) or drives a full agent turn via /api/v1/ws — reading the knowledge base and triggering LLM/api spend with no token.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated knowledge read + agent-turn + LLM cost abuse from any local process
findings.recommendation: Wire jwt_secret into an axum auth layer (Bearer check) or delete the dead fields; add same-origin check on WS upgrade

findings.title: Session archives (~/.zen/sessions) never deleted; no retention row covers sessions/ (incl. .jsonl.zst twins of compressed sessions)
findings.description: policies() table covers audit.jsonl, journal, iterations, outbox etc. but has NO row for sessions/. write path: zen-memory conversation.rs:45 paths.sessions().join(session_id). Only tool_calls.jsonl files are pruned (dream worker 30d).
findings.exploit_scenario: n/a (privacy+disk): every chat/TUI turn's full user/assistant content persists forever; compressed .zst twins also never removed
findings.impact: Unbounded disk growth + permanent retention of sensitive conversation content
findings.recommendation: Add AgeDelete policy for sessions (= journal 90d) after tombstone check; drop compressed twins

findings.title: Morning brief full body logged at info into zen.log, bypassing its own sensitivity classification
findings.description: info!("morning brief:\n{body}") — line 304 classifies sensitivity for the qqbot push but 308 logs the raw content regardless.
findings.exploit_scenario: Brief assembled from journal/memory (Private) lands verbatim in zen.log, which may be shipped to log collectors
findings.impact: PII/ Private-class user content in logs

findings.title: Raw user-derived decision text in warn logs (memory_curator.rs:378, session_journaler_signals.rs:751/773)
findings.description: warn!(error=%e, text=%text, "failed to route decision") — failure paths log full note/decision text.
findings.exploit_scenario: Error paths copy user content to zen.log
findings.impact: Sensitive content in logs on errors
findings.recommendation: Log char count + first-16-chars hash instead

findings.title: zen auth status prints first-8 + last-4 chars of the real API key to stdout
findings.description: format!("{}...{}", &key[..8], &key[key.len()-4..]) — 12 of ~48 chars disclosed, including provider prefix marker.
findings.exploit_scenario: Screen-share/terminal scrollback recording leaks usable partial key material
findings.recommendation: Unified mask-last-4 (mirror zen config show which already masks as [set])

findings.title: FR-040 boot-time temp sweep wired only into `zen workspace init`, sweeps workspace_root only — never daemon/TUI boot, never global root
findings.description: boot_time_sweep grep: sole production caller workspace_command.rs; daemon launchd cwd=/ has workspace_root=None → sweep never runs where tmp files actually live (vault/logs/sessions under global root).
findings.exploit_scenario: Error path leaks accumulate: write_atomic .tmp (atomic_file.rs:22-29 no fail-safe delete) and compression.rs:127-136 .zst.tmp survive crashes indefinitely
findings.impact: Orphaned temp files incl. partial sensitive content accumulate on global root
findings.recommendation: Call boot_time_sweep(paths.user_root()) in daemon startup + TUI init

findings.title: No .gitleaks.toml / .secretlintrc protection file
findings.description: Repo lacks a secrets-pre-commit guard; git history currently clean (verified) so it is a prevention gap only.
findings.exploit_scenario: Future accidental secret commit is not blocked pre-push

findings.title: Several production unsafe blocks lack SAFETY: justification (Constitution VI)
findings.description: transmute fn-ptr into sqlite3_auto_extension — no SAFETY comment; same shape shell_exec.rs:818 libc::kill,-pid; serve_command.rs:550/572/1229; sandbox_launcher.rs:185.
findings.exploit_scenario: n/a — latent audit debt, none actively exploitable
findings.recommendation: Add SAFETY comments or split out to justified modules

findings.title: LLM provider error reason carries full response payload into error→log chains (anthropic.rs:239, qqbot/api.rs:98)
findings.description: format!("Anthropic cached completion status {status}: {payload}") → e.to_string() logged by callers; qqbot/api.rs:98 error!(body=%text).
findings.exploit_scenario: Malicious/gateway-echoing API endpoint can inject user content or attacker text into logs via error body
findings.recommendation: Truncate payload to 200 chars in error reasons

findings.title: std-Mutex lock().unwrap()/expect() in every HTTP/WS request hot path
findings.description: SessionWire inbound .lock().unwrap() per frame; servers/dispatch/guards expect("lock poisoned") spread — poison propagates per-connection.
findings.exploit_scenario: n/a — dead-conn fraction; DoS excluded per filter but per-request unwraps are real error-surface
findings.impact: Request-path panic on poisoning instead of structured error
findings.recommendation: match on lock() with degraded log

findings.title: Working tree, config.toml, workflows known-clean (SecretRef indirections only; .env empty and untracked)
findings.description: Positive control: no sk-/AKIA/ghp_ matches; git full-history gitgrep = 0 matches.
